items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: One frame for a text control with adornments: InputGroup (size sm/md/lg, variant wrap), InputGroupInput, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupText. Children sit on the control scale (equal heights, whole pixels); the frame owns hover, the single focus ring, invalid, disabled and read-only.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Put icons in InputGroupAddon (decorative) or InputGroupButton (aria-label required). Set invalid, disabled or readOnly on the group (or aria-invalid / disabled / readOnly on the input). A button that can disappear stays mounted and toggles `invisible` so the group never changes size.
